question: Where and with what quality should one apply the cooling yogic practice?
premises: The practice is to be applied at the support-base location.
The practice is described as yoga.
The yoga is characterized as cool.
inference: One should apply the cooling yoga at the location of the support base.
uncertainties: ādhāra skandha saṃsthāne may refer to a specific subtle region
plain_english: One should apply the cooling yoga at the location of the support base.
